beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A bucket has forty-five pebbles. Thirty are put in, then fifty-four are taken out. How many pebbles are in the bucket now?

do.text: A bucket has $45$ pebbles. $30$ are put in, then $54$ are taken out. How many pebbles are in the bucket now?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Forty-five is the start. Each arrow is a change, something put in or taken out. The end is what we want to find.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Walk forward, one change at a time. First, thirty are put in.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Forty-five plus thirty is seventy-five. That is the middle number.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Then fifty-four are taken out. The second change starts from seventy-five, the middle number.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Seventy-five minus fifty-four is twenty-one. Twenty-one pebbles are in the bucket now.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Some marbles were in a bag. Twenty-eight were put in, then twenty-two were taken out. Now there are sixty-one. How many marbles were in the bag at first?

do.text: Some marbles were in a bag. $28$ were put in, then $22$ were taken out. Now there are $61$. How many marbles were in the bag at first?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The story puts in twenty-eight first, so sixty-one plus twenty-eight is eighty-nine. Then minus twenty-two is sixty-seven.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The last change was twenty-two taken out. We stand at the end, so walking back, we meet it first.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Going back undoes it: the twenty-two that were taken out are put back.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Next, the twenty-eight that were put in come back out.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Eighty-three minus twenty-eight is fifty-five. So the bag started with fifty-five.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Walking forward, fifty-five plus twenty-eight is eighty-three, and eighty-three minus twenty-two is sixty-one.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Sixty-one is the end of the story, so fifty-five is right.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Going back along a change does its opposite: what was taken out is put back, what was put in is taken out.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Forward: one change at a time. Backward: undo the last change first.

do.text: Forward: one change at a time
